title: Scalar Hom tower of an integral constructible complex at the point
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from D.p, and a finite extension E of Q_l. On s = Spec D.k, let S be any normalized derived reduction calculus and T any recorded coefficient tensor-Hom model. Restricted derived sections of quotient-linear Hom from S.reduction(N) into T.systemClosed's unit are naturally isomorphic, contravariantly in integral constructible N, to integralDualizingCoefficientHomTower applied to the actual derived integral R-module sections of N. This statement contains no compact support, compactification or exceptional inverse image.

source.place: Second proof paragraph: finite mapping-complex comparisons and reduction-compatible counits.

proof.text: The integral point reconstruction counit identifies N with extension of its actual R-module sections C. Use a flat-term K-flat model P of C, and the simultaneous reduction model of S, to realize its quotient-system reduction by constant extension of P and the actual quotient projections.

Apply scalar internal-Hom adjunction on the sequence site and point extension/sections adjunction. Specializing to the quotient unit gives Hom_R(P,I_n), where I is one simultaneous K-injective resolution of the actual quotient R-module tower. The tensor model identifies the target unit with the regular quotient sheaf, retaining every quotient map.

The uniqueness comparisons of localization identify this strict Hom tower with integralDualizingCoefficientHomTower. Naturality on complexes and inversion of quasi-isomorphisms gives the natural functor comparison; no family of evaluated isomorphisms is lifted.

theorem point_integral_reduction_hom_tower
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E (Spec (.of D.k)))
    (T : CoefficientDerivedSystemTensors l E (Spec (.of D.k))) :
    Nonempty ((sfIntegralConstructible l E (Spec (.of D.k))).ι.op ⋙ S.reduction.op ⋙
      (Functor.curry.obj (coefficientSequenceInternalHom l E (Spec (.of D.k)))).flip.obj
        T.systemClosed.monoidal.tensorUnit ⋙ coefPairingSections l E (Spec (.of D.k)) ≅
      ((sfIntegralConstructible l E (Spec (.of D.k))).ι ⋙
        integralDualizingDerivedSections l E (Spec (.of D.k))).op ⋙
          integralDualizingCoefficientHomTower l E)
